name: Hilde Vautmans - § 1, point k - Am 32
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: k) take action to prevent further security risks arising from Chinese foreign investment by strengthening foreign direct investment (FDI) screening in Member States, particularly in strategic sectors such as media services, critical raw materials, critical infrastructure and technologies; and, where appropriate, consider the geopolitical and economic implications of Chinese investment in critical infrastructure in the Member States over the last decade, and address the monopolistic positions of China in critical and essential chokepoints by prioritising the strengthening of alternative resilient supply chains;
